final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON CAST(r.transreg AS TEXT) = CAST(a.translink AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader t ON CAST(t.tradereg AS TEXT) = CAST(r.trdref AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.k AS k, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.tot AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.k AS k, s3.c AS c, s3.share AS share, s3.c - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.av) SELECT SUM(c) AS sum_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s5
